rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Enables AI agents to automatically deploy cookie consent management solutions through natural language commands. Built on Cloudflare Workers, it handles domain registration, template assignment supporting Google Consent Mode, Microsoft UET, and Meta, and generates integration code in a single operation. Designed for developers working with Claude Desktop, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor to implement GDPR compliance with minimal effort.
